basic_details.job_title: HBCH&RC Muzaffarpur Recruitment 2026 – Walkin for 4 Medical Physicist, Technician Posts
basic_details.short_information: M/s. SBC Exports Ltd., an outsourcing agency supplying manpower on contract basis, will hold a walk-in interview on 7 December 2026 (between 9:00 am and 10:00 am) for 4 posts, 1 Medical Physicist and 3 Technician (Radiotherapy), to be deployed at Homi Bhabha Cancer Hospital and Research Centre (HBCH&RC), Muzaffarpur. Outstation candidates who want an online interview must email their documents to [email protected] by 3 December 2026, 3:00 PM. This is a private contract job through an agency, not a direct government appointment.

qualification.details: Essential education: M.Sc. (Physics) and Diploma in Radiological Physics or Equivalent AERB approved qualifications. Certificate of Radiological Safety Officer from AERB is desirable but not essential. One-year clinical experience as Medical Physicist with state of art technology will be preferable. Desirable experience: computer programming skills in C++, MATLAB, Python etc. Age limit: 35 years, as on the walk-in interview date. | Essential education: B.Sc. (Physics) with minimum 50% marks and Post Graduate Diploma in Radiotherapy Technology from recognized institute / university approved by AERB, with minimum 01-year experience in modern Radiotherapy Technology. OR B.Sc. (Radiotherapy Technology) - 3/4 years course from a recognized institute / university approved by AERB, with minimum 3 years' experience in modern Radiotherapy Technology. Age limit: 30 years, as on the walk-in interview date. | The notice prints no age relaxation. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

content_sections.heading: About SBC Exports
content_sections.text: M/s. SBC Exports Ltd. describes itself in the notice as an outsourcing agency for the supply of manpower services to HBCH&RC, Muzaffarpur, on contract basis. The posts are for deployment at Homi Bhabha Cancer Hospital and Research Centre, in the Shri Krishna Medical College and Hospital Campus, Umanagar, Muzaffarpur.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Eligible candidates may attend the interview at Homi Bhabha Cancer Hospital and Research Centre, Shri Krishna Medical College and Hospital Campus, Umanagar, Muzaffarpur (Bihar) – 842004, on 7 December 2026 between 09:00 am and 10:00 am. Outstation candidates may attend the interview online. They must write the post they have applied for in the email subject line. They must send their Resume with Educational Certificates, Experience Certificates and a copy of Aadhar and PAN Card in a single PDF file to [email protected] . The email must reach by 3 December 2026, up to 3:00 PM, for both posts. Only shortlisted candidates who fulfil the norms will be contacted for the online interview. The notice states that accommodation will not be provided to outstation candidates.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: Essential education: M.Sc. (Physics) and Diploma in Radiological Physics or Equivalent AERB approved qualifications. Certificate of Radiological Safety Officer from AERB is desirable but not essential. One-year clinical experience as Medical Physicist with state of art technology will be preferable. Desirable experience: computer programming skills in C++, MATLAB, Python etc. Age limit: 35 years, as on the walk-in interview date. Essential education: B.Sc. (Physics) with minimum 50% marks and Post Graduate Diploma in Radiotherapy Technology from recognized institute / university approved by AERB, with minimum 01-year experience in modern Radiotherapy Technology. OR B.Sc. (Radiotherapy Technology) - 3/4 years course from a recognized institute / university approved by AERB, with minimum 3 years' experience in modern Radiotherapy Technology. Age limit: 30 years, as on the walk-in interview date. The notice prints no age relaxation. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Candidates attending in person must carry: Bio-data Recent passport size photograph PAN Card Aadhar Card Educational and Experience Certificates in original, with one set of self-attested copies Outstation candidates applying by email send the Resume, Educational Certificates, Experience Certificates and copies of Aadhar and PAN Card together in a single PDF file.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: The notice announces a walk-in interview at the hospital campus in Muzaffarpur. For outstation candidates, the interview may be held online, and only shortlisted candidates who fulfil the norms will be contacted for it. The notice does not describe marking or any other stage.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in SBC Exports Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 4 posts: 1 Medical Physicist and 3 Technician (Radiotherapy), for deployment at HBCH&RC, Muzaffarpur.

faq.question: Q2. When is the SBC Exports walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is on 7 December 2026 between 09:00 am and 10:00 am at Homi Bhabha Cancer Hospital and Research Centre, Umanagar, Muzaffarpur (Bihar) – 842004.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date for outstation candidates to request an online interview?
faq.answer: The email must be received by 3 December 2026, up to 3:00 PM, at [email protected], with the post name in the subject line.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification for Medical Physicist?
faq.answer: M.Sc. (Physics) and Diploma in Radiological Physics or Equivalent AERB approved qualifications. The AERB Radiological Safety Officer certificate is desirable but not essential.

faq.question: Q5. What is the qualification for Technician (Radiotherapy)?
faq.answer: Either B.Sc. (Physics) with minimum 50% marks and a PG Diploma in Radiotherapy Technology with 1 year experience, or B.Sc. (Radiotherapy Technology) with 3 years' experience in modern Radiotherapy Technology.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The age limit is 35 years for Medical Physicist and 30 years for Technician (Radiotherapy), as on the walk-in interview date.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary for these posts?
faq.answer: Medical Physicist gets Rs. 50,000 per month. Technician (Radiotherapy) gets Rs. 25,506 to Rs. 30,000 per month.

faq.question: Q8. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No, it is a contract appointment through M/s. SBC Exports Ltd., initially for six months and extendable, if required.

faq.question: Q9. What should I carry to the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Carry Bio-data, a recent passport size photograph, PAN Card, Aadhar Card, and Educational and Experience Certificates in original with one set of self-attested copies.

faq.question: Q10. Will accommodation be provided to outstation candidates?
faq.answer: No, the notice states that accommodation will not be provided, and outstation candidates may attend the interview online instead.
